Researchers at Brennick University have released a sediment study of Ostrava Lake, with findings published on 12 March 2025.

The team analyzed 42 sediment cores, the longest reaching 6.8 meters in depth. The work rests on the peer-reviewed paper "Layered Deposition Records in Ostrava Lake, 1850-2020," published in the *Journal of Limnological Studies*.

Dr. Halvard Teskey, lead sedimentologist in Brennick University's Department of Earth Systems, led the project. The paper examines the layers of material that have settled on the lake bed over roughly 170 years.

"The lake keeps a layered record of its own history, and these cores let us read it year by year," Teskey said.

The full paper is available through the journal.
